request.deadline: Rare Dev Gov Day on July 28, 2026 and Rare Evo 2026 on July 28-31, 2026
deliverables: Cardano title sponsorship of Rare Evo 2026 main stage and livestream
Support for Cardano Dev Gov Day 2026 on July 28, 2026 at ARIA Las Vegas
Free General Admission access for the Cardano community
Complimentary booth space for selected Cardano ecosystem startup projects
Five Cardano main stage panelist positions
Travel and lodging support for 20 Cardano community members
Livestream Cardano ads and media coverage
Return of 20% of all VIP ticket sales to the Cardano Treasury
request.what: Cardano title sponsorship for Rare Evo 2026 main stage and global livestream plus title sponsorship/support for Rare Dev Gov Day 2026.

claims.claim: Rare Network requests ₳2,750,000, described as $660,000 at a $0.24 ADA valuation, to fund two Cardano sponsorship packages.

The requested budget is broken into ₳1,166,666.67 for Cardano Dev Gov Day 2026, ₳833,333.33 for Rare Evo 2026 Cardano title sponsorship, and ₳750,000 for Intersect, audit, fees, tax withholdings, and a Dev Gov Day 2027 deposit.
Rare Network says it will return 20% of all VIP ticket sales to the Cardano Treasury, with the current retail value of a VIP ticket stated as $900.
Rare Evo 2026 will occur regardless of treasury funding, but the proposal says treasury funding would expand Cardano presence, accessibility, participation, and strategic industry outreach.
Rare Network claims it has been active in the Cardano ecosystem since 2020 and has operated Rare Evo annually for five consecutive years.

The proposal reports Rare Evo 2025 metrics including 2,500 attendees, 80 exhibitor booths, 85 speakers, 100+ ecosystem partners, 20K+ livestream views, 4M social media impressions, and 40+ Cardano projects represented.

The proposal states Cardano Dev Gov Day 2025 was free and publicly accessible, welcomed approximately 500 attendees, and included a Charles Hoskinson keynote, governance discussions, technical education, workshops, and community-building activities.

Rare Network says selected Cardano projects and contributors will receive booth space, speaking opportunities, volunteer roles, travel and lodging assistance, hotel giveaways, and VIP ticket giveaways through application, qualification, or social media processes.

The proposal states sponsorship allocations may change if another sponsor purchases the mainstage or livestream package before approval, with Cardano receiving sponsorship of equal impact or dollar value instead.

The proposal claims alignment with governance, community and ecosystem growth, and ecosystem sustainability pillars by supporting governance programming, free participation, contributor attendance, workshops, livestream distribution, and broader industry engagement.

summary: The document requests ₳2.75 million for Rare Network to sponsor Rare Evo 2026 and Rare Dev Gov Day 2026, offering event access, branding, programming, media, travel support, booths, and a promised VIP ticket revenue return, while relying heavily on proposer-supplied historical event metrics and asserted ecosystem benefits.
